source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API + raw WZ API; class-specific 5th job skill list cross-checked against maplestorywiki.net
notes: 3rd/4th/6th-job skillbooks (15211/15212/15214) return a deterministic cast error from the skillbook endpoint; being fetched via the raw WZ API.
5th-job V skills are being fetched via the raw WZ API (40002).

skills.name: Lucent Gauntlet Mastery
skills.description: Improves your mastery of the Lucent Gauntlet, granting you greater combat prowess.

skills.name: Lucent Brand
skills.description: Marks you with the light of the crystal, heightening your power.

skills.name: Radiant Javelin
skills.description:
Conjures a magical javelin that dashes back and forth between enemies. The javelin targets the boss with the highest HP first.
Can be linked with Radiant Orb, and does not benefit from skills which increase the max number of targets.

skills.name: Radiant Orb
skills.description:
Conjures a magical orb that flies toward your deployed crystal. If your crystal is not deployed, it instead flies straight. The Orb grants you a Lucent Brand, and increases the damage of Radiant Javelin for a set time.
Levels up alongside Radiant Javelin.

skills.name: Ex
skills.description:
Summons Ex, your trustworthy robo-companion. Ex attacks a single enemy for a set time.
Unaffected by Attack Reflection.

skills.name: Crystalline Wings
skills.description:
Conjures a crystal portal for teleportation.
Use the up arrow key and jump together to leap up during a jump.
You can fly freely for a short time by holding down the skill key and pressing the arrow keys to maneuver while in mid-air.

skills.name: Crystalline Wings
skills.description:
Conjures a crystal portal for short-distance teleportation.
After use, you can fly freely for a short time when you use the skill again while jumping.

skills.name: Reaction - Destruction
skills.description: Resonates the crystal when it collides with Radiant Javelin, releasing destructive energy on enemies near the crystal.

skills.name: Reaction - Domination
skills.description: Resonates the crystal when it comes into contact with a Radiant Orb, striking nearby enemies and marking them with an Umbral Brand.

skills.name: Crystal Battery
skills.description: Stores energy in your crystal to be used to cast more advanced magic.

skills.name: Aegis of Light
skills.description: Reduces damage taken using the power of the mytocrystals. Absorb the enemy's MP when attacking with Magic skills using the overflowing magical energy of the mytocrystals. Absorption efficiency is reduced against bosses, resulting in less MP gained.

skills.name: Umbral Brand
skills.description: Marks foes with a shadowy brand that renders them vulnerable to your attacks. Enemies suffer reduced Defense, and take additional damage from all of Illium's attacks (excluding Radiant Orb).

skills.name: Elder Crystal
skills.description: A crystal filled with immense, ancient power. Used to perform a number of magical skills.

skills.name: Deploy Crystal
skills.description:
Summons and commands the mysterious Elder Crystal.
Use the skill to deploy your crystal. On reuse, it is moved a set distance ahead of you.
When used while pressing the Down Arrow key, the crystal is transported a set distance in front of you. Pressing the Up Arrow Key will move it to your current position.

skills.name: Crystal Skill - Vortex of Light
skills.description:
Unleashes the magical power accumulated in the crystal, tearing through nearby enemies.
Crystal Charge Required: 30
Crystal Battery must be reset after each use.

skills.name: Gauntlet Frenzy
skills.description: Increases the Attack Speed of your Lucent Gauntlet.

skills.name: Machina
skills.description:
Summons your mechanical friend Machina near your deployed crystal.
Machina defends your crystal, drawing in the enemy.
He follows the movement of your crystal, attacking enemies along his path. While moving, the numbers of enemies hit is reduced by 1.
Unaffected by Attack Reflection.

skills.name: Reaction - Destruction II
skills.description:
Enhances Reaction - Destruction.
Triggers when Radiant Javelin or Longinus Spear come into contact with your crystal, releasing a destructive blast that strikes nearby enemies two times.

skills.name: Reaction - Domination II
skills.description:
Enhances Reaction - Domination.
Triggers when your crystal comes into contact with a Radiant Orb, striking nearby enemies and marking them with an Umbral Brand.

skills.name: Winged Javelin
skills.description: A Javelin enhanced by the power of your Wings of Glory. Automatically pursues enemies and explodes on contact, inflicting severe damage. The javelin targets the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: Crystal Battery II
skills.description: Stores a greater amount of energy in your crystal, to be used to cast more advanced magic.

skills.name: Lucent Brand II
skills.description: Strengthens the Lucent Brand.

skills.name: Umbral Brand II
skills.description: Strengthens the Umbral Brand.

skills.name: Might of the Flora
skills.description: Calls upon the ancestral magicks of the Flora.

skills.name: Tenacity
skills.description: Despite your lack of innate magical talent, your perseverance studying the magical arts has not gone unrewarded.

skills.name: Endless Research
skills.description: Your unending studies of magic grant you additional Magic ATT, Critical Damage, and Critical Rate.

skills.name: Crystalline Wings - Boost
skills.description: Enhances maneuverability by boosting the range of Crystalline Wings.

skills.name: Crystal Skill - Wings of Glory
skills.description:
Infuse your wings with the magic of the Elder Crystal and temporarily gain the ability to fly.
If the skill is used in grounded mode, you will not fly.
While active, Radiant Javelin is enhanced to Winged Javelin to target the boss with the highest HP first, exploding on contact. Its Attack Power is also increased.
While active, casting Crystalline Wings while holding a directional key will teleport you more quickly in that direction. Pressing the skill key again will cancel its usage immediately.
Wings of Glory is not affected by buff duration bonuses, and upon casting, grants immunity to debilitating abnormal status attacks for a set duration. When Wings of Glory ends, Machina and Elder Crystal will be automatically summoned.
Grounded Mode On/Off: Right-click
Crystal Charge Cost: 150

skills.name: Crystal Skill - Resonance
skills.description:
Illium resonates in harmony with the Elder Crystal, causing a beam of light to travel between the two. The beam restores health and grants a Lucent Brand upon making contact with Illium or a party member, but instead afflicts enemies it touches with an Umbral Brand.
Crystal Charge Required: 60
Crystal Battery must be reset after each use.

skills.name: Radiant Javelin II
skills.description:
Enhances Radiant Javelin to splinter into shards on contact, dealing an additional attack.
Can be linked with Radiant Orb II, and does not benefit from skills which increase the max number of targets. The javelin and magic missile target the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: Radiant Orb II
skills.description:
Enhances Radiant Orb.
Levels up alongside Radiant Javelin II and can be linked.

skills.name: Resonant Wings
skills.description:
Triggers automatically during Wings of Glory
Causes you to radiate a brilliant light that marks foes with Umbral Brands and party members with Lucent Brands.

skills.name: Lucent Brand III
skills.description: Perfects the Lucent Brand.

skills.name: Umbral Brand III
skills.description: Perfects the Umbral Brand.

skills.name: Crystal Battery III
skills.description: Stores an enormous amount of energy in your crystal, to be used to case the most advanced magicks.

skills.name: Wisdom of the Crystal
skills.description: Your extensive studies of the Elder Crystal have taught you how to draw forth its true power.

skills.name: Javelin - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the Damage of Radiant Javelin and Winged Javelin.

skills.name: Javelin - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks dealt by Radiant Javelin and Winged Javelin. However, it does not increase the number of attacks for shards and projectiles.

skills.name: Javelin - Boss Rush
skills.description: Increases the Boss Damage of Radiant Javelin and Winged Javelin.

skills.name: Longinus - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Longinus Spear's damage.

skills.name: Longinus - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases Longinus Spear's Attack Count.

skills.name: Longinus - Cooldown Cutter
skills.description: Reduces the cooldown of Longinus Spear.

skills.name: Deus - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Crystal Skill - Deus's damage.

skills.name: Deus - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases Crystal Skill - Deus's Attack Count.

skills.name: Deus - Boss Rush
skills.description: Increases damage when against Boss Monsters when using Crystal Skill - Deus.

skills.name: Longinus Spear
skills.description: Casts the holy spear Longinus in the direction of your deployed crystal, inflicting severe damage to all enemies in its path. If no crystal is deployed, it instead flies straight.

skills.name: Crystal Skill - Deus
skills.description:
Unites the powers of Ex and Machina to summon Deus. Deus can create satellites that pursue and attack nearby enemies.
Unaffected by attack reflection and Summon Duration increases.
Crystal Charge Required: 90
Crystal Battery must be reset after each use.

skills.name: Vortex Wings
skills.description:
Focuses all your magic into your wings to deliver a brutal spin attack. The condensed magic marks the enemy with a shadowy brand.
Usable once per Wings of Glory

skills.name: Hero of the Flora
skills.description: Your hidden potential as a Flora increases your stats. Using the skill creates a Flora emblem.

skills.name: Floran Hero's Will
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.
Can be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Flash Crystal Battery
skills.description:
Immediately charges Crystal.
Not affected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Longinus Zone
skills.description: Summons 6 Longinus Spears to unleash a devastating attack over a large area.

skills.name: Divine Wrath
skills.description: Borrows strength from the ancient god of the Flora.

skills.name: Crystalline Bulwark
skills.description: Grants you and your party invincibility for a set time. That time will increase in proportion to your current Lucent Brand stack count.

skills.name: Crystal Ignition
skills.description:
Fires an intense beam of energy that scorches everything in its path.
You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.
Can move while holding the skill key. Upon hitting an enemy, Lucent Brand is refreshed.

skills.name: Reaction - Spectral Blast
skills.note: effect0 (1 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.

skills.name: Templar Knight
skills.description:
Summons a mechanical warrior wielding a weapon forged from light.
The Templar Knight targets the boss with the highest HP within range first.
The Templar Knight ignores Attack Reflection.

skills.name: Crystalline Spirit
skills.description:
Use the power of mytocrystals to form a crystalline spirit and drive your enemies away. Can activate the Reaction skill with the crystalline spirit.
Does not reduce the number of enemies that can be attacked when the Radiant Javelin comes into contact.
Cannot use while Wings of Glory is active.

skills.name: Crystal Gate
skills.description:
Use advanced crystal technology to create passages you can move through freely. When you press the Up Arrow key to activate a Crystal Gate, you can move to the next Crystal Gate in the order they were created. If you use the last Crystal Gate that was created, you will move back to the first Crystal Gate.
The gates must be recharged after each use, and the gates that you activated will take longer to recharge. You can receive enhancement and attack support during the Crystal Gate duration, and gates can be set up in the air.
Moving through the passage between gates counts toward necessary distances to activate the flow of combat.

skills.name: Crystal Attunement
skills.description:
Modifies the mytocrystal by infusing it with magical power.
After using the skill, use the arrow keys to select Crystalline Spirit or Crystalline Essence.

skills.name: Crystalline Essence
skills.description: Absorbs the power of mytocrystals to automatically imitate its Reaction skill. Cannot activate while Wings of Glory is in use.

skills.name: HEXA Umbral Brand III
skills.description: Deals a powerful additional hit on enemies marked with the Umbral Brand. Permanently enhances HEXA Radiant Javelin.

skills.name: HEXA Radiant Javelin
skills.description:
Conjures a magical javelin that darts back and forth between enemies. The javelin splinters into shards on contact, unleashing an additional attack.
Can be linked with Radiant Orb II, and does not benefit from skills that increase the max number of targets.
When a javelin hits a mytocrystal or an enemy, a Mytocrystal Shard is obtained. If you collect a certain amount of Mytocrystal Shards, you can use an Enchanted Javelin, giving the javelin the accumulated mytocrystal power. Enchanted Javelins automatically target enemies.
Javelins, Enchanted Javelins, and Javelin Shards target the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: HEXA Radiant Enchanted Javelin
skills.description:
Throws 3 magical javelins that automatically track and attack enemies by giving the javelin the mytocrystal power accumulated in the mytocrystal shards.
The javelins dart back and forth between enemies and if they hit an enemy, splinter into shards on contact, unleashing an additional attack.
Can be linked with Radiant Orb II, and does not benefit from skills that increase the max number of targets.
Javelins and Javelin Shards target the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: HEXA Winged Javelin
skills.description:
Throws a javelin enhanced by the power of your Wings of Glory. Automatically pursues enemies and explodes on contact, inflicting severe damage. When used, magic missiles that track down enemies are created with it.
Obtain Glory Mytocrystal Shards whenever the javelin hits an enemy. If you collect a certain amount of Glory Mytocrystal Shards, you can use an Enchanted Javelin by giving the javelin the accumulated mytocrystal power.
Javelins and magic missiles prioritize targeting the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: HEXA Winged Enchanted Javelin
skills.description:
Throws 3 javelins enhanced by the power of your Wings of Glory. Automatically pursues enemies and explodes on impact, inflicting severe damage.
When used, magic missiles that track enemies are created with it. Javelins and magic missiles target the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: HEXA Reaction - Destruction
skills.description: Triggers when Radiant Javelin or Longinus Spear come into contact with your crystal. Releases a destructive blast that strikes nearby enemies two times and mark them with an Umbral Brand.

skills.name: HEXA Reaction - Domination
skills.description: Resonates the crystal when it comes into contact with a Radiant Orb, striking nearby enemies and marking them with an Umbral Brand.

skills.name: HEXA Vortex Wings
skills.description:
Focuses all your magic into your wings to deliver a brutal spin attack. The condensed magic marks the enemy with a shadowy brand.
Permanently enhances the Enchanted Javelin of HEXA Radiant Javelin and HEXA Winged Javelin.
Usable once per Wings of Glory

skills.name: HEXA Ex
skills.description:
Summons your trustworthy robo-companion, Ex. Ex attacks a single enemy for a set time.
Unaffected by enemy attack reflection and receives summon duration increase effect.

skills.name: HEXA Machina
skills.description:
Summons your mechanical friend Machina near your deployed crystal.
Machina defends your crystal, drawing in the enemy. He follows the movement of your crystal, attacking enemies along his path.
Does not trigger attack reflection and receives a summon duration increase effect.

skills.name: HEXA Crystal Skill - Deus
skills.description:
Unites the powers of Ex and Machina to summon Deus. Deus can create satellites that pursue and attack nearby enemies.
Unaffected by attack reflection.
Crystal Charge Required: 90
Crystal Battery must be reset after each use.

skills.name: HEXA Longinus Spear
skills.description: Casts the holy spear Longinus in the direction of your deployed crystal, inflicting severe damage to all enemies in its path. If no crystal is deployed, it instead flies straight. Hitting an enemy or the mytocrystal immediately charges the mytocrystal with a large amount of magic.

skills.name: HEXA Longinus Zone
skills.description: Summons 6 Longinus Spears to unleash a devastating attack over a large area.

skills.name: Mytocrystal Expanse
skills.description:
Unleashes the infinite magic power contained in the mytocrystal, causing it to explode and summon more mytocrystals.
The unlimited mytocrystal resonates whenever the mytocrystal causes a reaction, causing a powerful chain reaction. If the reaction is activated more than a certain number of times, the pure magic condensed in the unlimited mytocrystal erupts to create a mytocrystal crystal.
When using the unlimited mytocrystal while Wings of Glory is active, the mytocrystal's infinite magic power dwells in the Wings of Glory, increasing Wings of Glory's duration. The buff duration increase effect does not apply to the increased duration.
The mytocrystal crystal prioritizes targeting the boss with the highest HP first. Unaffected by attack reflection.

Lv. 10: Ignore Defense +20%
Lv. 20: Boss Damage +20%
Lv. 30: Ignore Defense +30% and Boss Damage +30%

skills.name: Mytocrystal Expanse
skills.description:
Unleashes the infinite magic power contained in the mytocrystal, causing it to explode and summon more mytocrystals.
The unlimited mytocrystal resonates whenever the mytocrystal causes a reaction, causing a powerful chain reaction. If the reaction is activated more than a certain number of times, the pure magic condensed in the unlimited mytocrystal erupts to create a mytocrystal crystal.
The mytocrystal crystal prioritizes targeting the boss with the highest HP first. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Mytocrystal Expanse
skills.description: The unlimited mytocrystal resonates with the mytocrystal's reaction.

skills.name: Mytocrystal Expanse
skills.description: The pure magic condensed in the unlimited mytocrystal erupts to create a mytocrystal crystal.

skills.name: Excidium
skills.description:
Draws on the full power of the mytocrystal to fire the orbital weapon, Excidium.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%
